text: The public database interface now exposes markRead, markMarked, markReplied, markNotNew and markKilled with keys. Native virtual MarkHdrRead and MarkHdrReadInDB remain as internal implementation hooks. nsNewsDatabase overrides MarkHdrRead to update the newsrc read set and issue NotifyReadChanged. Do not remove that override path just because the scriptable convenience methods were retired. This is source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Removing public header flag wrappers retains native read overrides
